description: This file is a Java class implementing a REST controller for the notesbackend application. It provides basic endpoints such as welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for the notesbackend application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message at the root endpoint '/'

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI at '/swagger-ui.html' for API documentation

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns 'OK' indicating the application health status at '/health'
